classification: post-development repair verification; not independent held-out acceptance
boundaries: The three topics were selected after development and are not independent held-out cases.
Use the production JobService, OfficialSitemapProvider, Fetcher and extractor; production never reads saved probe XML or report fixtures.
Independent wrappers bound every target HTTP including robots, sitemap index, child sitemap, resource page, redirect and catalog follow-up; DoH A and AAAA HTTP are separately counted.
Start from robots-declared same-origin sitemap; course/resource URLs must be actual loc values, never derived by stripping sitemap paths.
Stop at access restriction, byte/network/deadline/total budget without replacement or rerun; preserve partial and empty results.
Use an isolated fresh SQLite database and preserve full job/evidence; never modify the old held-out report or production database.
Static page/course/video evidence does not establish playback. Any final pass/partial decision must inspect actual records, not only runner exit code.
